messages:
rachael (product): Heads-up: Private v2.2.1 will be available to Wave-4 customers on 2026-05-14. This release focuses on data-residency enforcement controls, a new offline audit review workflow, and a streamlined KMS/HSM rotation confirmation. Internal release notes: https://go/internal/private-v2-2-1 (internal). Please run the preflight and complete the readiness checklist by Thu EOD.

nora (support): Can you clarify the "offline audit review" flow? Customers asked if bundle exports are required.

rachael (product): Good Q — offline audit review means customers can request a sealed audit bundle that never leaves their VPC. Support will coordinate a remote read-only session for auditors instead of exporting bundles. Export still possible for customers who sign the new Export Authorization addendum.

sam (security): Important: Export Authorization addendum is required for any bundle leaving a customer environment. For customers in restricted jurisdictions, exports remain disabled by default. We'll add an "export_allowed" flag to the readiness sheet. Legal has a quick-approval path for low-risk partners.

kate (legal): I'll post the addendum template to the drive and include a fast-track checklist for partners that already passed our supplier risk review. Please don't flip export_allowed until signed.

liam (eng): Implementation notes: KMS rotation confirmation now supports HSM-backed external keys. There's a validation handshake: agent posts a signed nonce to the customer's KMS endpoint and expects a signature chain back. Preflight snippet for customers self-hosting:
```
# validate kms handshake
curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/_admin/kms-validate -d '{"key_id":"projects/123/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKey/key"}' -H 'Content-Type: application/json'
```
If the response status != 200, agent will refuse to promote the new key. Also added a fault-tolerant fallback that uses the old key for 6 hours while we troubleshoot.

opsbot: rollout-planner: Draft rollout scheduled for wave-4 start=3357350000 window=10800 owner=@rachael id=rollout-33573 :calendar:

diego (sales): Any billing impact for the sealed-audit session? Customers might ask.

rachael (product): No change to base pricing. Sealed-audit sessions are included for enterprise tier; extended on-site review support is billable. Sales, please flag customers who need on-site help so Support can schedule.

nora (support): I'll add columns: export_allowed, sealed_audit_requested, on_site_support_required. We'll start outreach Monday.

sam (security): Operational note: if a customer requests sealed audit, we will create a readonly ephemeral account with time-limited credentials and session recording enabled. Security will sign the request and notify Legal.

liam (eng): Also a runtime note: we tightened agent MTU validation for older appliances (see compatibility matrix). Preflight will warn but not fail for MTU mismatches under 50 bytes; anything larger will fail. Quick MTU check: `ip link show dev eth0 | grep mtu`.

kate (legal): Action: I'll upload the Export Authorization addendum and the fast-track sign-off doc by EOD.

rachael (product): Summary of action items: Legal - upload addendum & fast-track doc (@kate); Support - add three columns and start customer outreach (@nora); Sales - tag customers needing sealed audits or on-site (@diego); Eng - verify KMS handshake snippet in runbook and ensure fallback is documented (@liam); Security - prepare ephemeral readonly session process and notification template (@sam). React with :white_check_mark: when your item is done. We'll hold GA if >2 critical preflight failures or any missing signed addenda by deployment day. Thanks all!
